tools.name: precoro_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders (POs) with number (idn), supplier, location, totals, currency, required date, approval status, receiving status (0 not received, 1 partly, 2 received) and payment status (0 needs invoice, 1 not paid, 2 partly paid, 3 paid). Line items come only from precoro_get_purchase_order. F

tools.name: precoro_get_purchase_order
tools.description: One purchase order by IDN with all items, taxes, custom fields, approval steps, receiving and payment status. GET /purchaseorders/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_purchase_requisitions
tools.description: List purchase requisitions (purchase requests): requester, location, totals, required date, approval status. Line items come only from precoro_get_purchase_requisition. Filter by status, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. GET /purchaserequisitions.

tools.name: precoro_get_purchase_requisition
tools.description: One purchase requisition by IDN with items, custom fields and approval steps. GET /purchaserequisitions/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices and credit notes: supplier, totals, currency, issue and due dates, paid sum, approval/payment status. Filter by status, kind, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. GET /invoices.

tools.name: precoro_get_invoice
tools.description: One supplier invoice or credit note by IDN with items, taxes, matching to purchase orders and receipts, and payments. GET /invoices/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_expenses
tools.description: List expense documents (purchases without a purchase order): supplier, totals, currency, status and payment status. Filter by status, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. GET /expenses.

tools.name: precoro_get_expense
tools.description: One expense document by IDN with items, custom fields and approval steps. GET /expenses/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_receipts
tools.description: List goods receipts (what was delivered against purchase orders): purchase order, status and dates. Line items and received quantities come only from precoro_get_receipt. Filter by status, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. GET /receipts.

tools.name: precoro_get_receipt
tools.description: One goods receipt by IDN with items and approval steps. GET /receipts/{idn}.

tools.name: precoro_list_payments
tools.description: List payments recorded against invoices and expenses: pay date, sum paid, status (0 paid, 8 canceled), kind (0 payment, 1 credit, 2 supplier credit balance, 3-6 prepayments/credits) and the invoice or expense paid. GET /payments.

tools.name: precoro_list_budgets
tools.description: List budgets with name, period, total sum, how much is used in purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoices and expenses, and whether the limit is enforced. GET /budgets.

tools.name: precoro_list_contracts
tools.description: List supplier contracts with number, supplier, begin and end dates and whether they auto-prolong. GET /contracts.

tools.name: precoro_list_ap_inbox
tools.description: List documents in the accounts-payable inbox (uploaded or emailed supplier invoices read by OCR): file name, supplier, gross total, currency, status, upload and processed dates. GET /ap/documents.

tools.name: precoro_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers: name, unique code, currencies, payment conditions, minimum order sum, contact and address fields, accounting ids, status. Bank details are never returned. Filter by last-modified time. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: precoro_get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier by id with contacts, conditions, custom field defaults and credit balance. Bank details are never returned. GET /suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: precoro_list_items
tools.description: List catalog items (products and services): name, SKU, unit, price, currency, supplier, group and custom fields. Filter by last-modified time. GET /items.

tools.name: precoro_get_item
tools.description: One catalog item by id. GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: precoro_list_reference_data
tools.description: List a configuration table: users (name, email, roles), locations, legal_entities, taxes, payment_terms, units, warehouses, product_groups, document_custom_fields (departments, projects, classes, GL accounts), item_custom_fields or supplier_custom_fields. Use it to find the ids that purchase requisi

tools.name: precoro_approve_document
tools.description: WRITE: approve a document as the Precoro user the API key belongs to (that user must be a current approver of it). Approving can release spending: an approved purchase order may be sent to the supplier and an approved invoice can go to payment. Find candidates with the list tools and waiting_for_my_

tools.name: precoro_reject_document
tools.description: WRITE: reject (deny) a document that is waiting for the key user's approval. A comment is required; the creator is notified and sees it. POST /{document}/{idn}/reject.

tools.name: precoro_submit_document
tools.description: WRITE: confirm a draft (open) document so it enters the approval flow (or is approved at once if no approval is needed). Approvers are notified. POST /{document}/{idn}/confirm.

tools.name: precoro_create_purchase_requisition
tools.description: WRITE: create a purchase requisition in draft (open) status for the key user; it is not submitted for approval until precoro_submit_document is called. Needs a location id, a currency, a delivery date and at least one item (a catalog item_id, or a name with quantity and price). Find ids with precoro

tools.name: precoro_create_supplier
tools.description: WRITE: create a supplier. The name must be unique in the company (a duplicate name, unique code or registration number is rejected). The supplier is available to all legal entities. Depending on the company's settings it may need approval before it can be used on orders. Returns the new supplier. PO

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: precoro_list_invoices, precoro_list_ap_inbox, precoro_list_reference_data, precoro_approve_document, precoro_submit_document, precoro_create_purchase_requisition · Private data: precoro_list_expenses, precoro_get_expense, precoro_list_ap_inbox, precoro_list_suppliers, precoro_get_supplier, precoro_approve_document, precoro_reject_document, precoro_submit_document, precoro_create_purchase_requisition · Public sink: precoro_list_ap_inbox, precoro_list_reference_data, precoro_approve_document, precoro_reject_document, precoro_submit_document, precoro_create_purchase_requisition, precoro_create_supplier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: precoro_list_invoices, precoro_list_ap_inbox, precoro_list_reference_data, precoro_approve_document, precoro_submit_document, precoro_create_purchase_requisition · Private data: precoro_list_expenses, precoro_get_expense, precoro_list_ap_inbox, precoro_list_suppliers, precoro_get_supplier, precoro_approve_document, precoro_reject_document, precoro_submit_document, precoro_create_purchase_requisition · Public sink: precoro_list_ap_inbox, precoro_list_reference_data, precoro_approve_document, precoro_reject_document, precoro_submit_document, precoro_create_purchase_requisition, precoro_create_supplier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
